text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan tell Yaeno Muteki about their injuries. It's still uncertain when—or if—they'll be able to return to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're worried that no one will be waiting for them when they return, so Yaeno Muteki promises that she'll continue racing to keep their names in the mind of the public.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hoping to remind the audience of the racers she ran against her two friends, Yaeno Muteki decides to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the Arima Kinen, the crowd buzzes with excitement at the prospect of another face-off between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Yaeno Muteki is determined to steal all of their attention with a stunning performance.
